scripts/validate-smto-site-content.py

Python · Tier B

Validate public content, rendered links, release schema and structural budgets offline.

Usage

python scripts/validate-smto-site-content.py

Inputs

SMTO_SITE_* settings and explicit public content/release manifests.

Side effects

Reads local public inputs and prints counts. No network, files or services mutated.

Cleanup

None; immutable registries expire with this process.

@see src/smto_site/validation.py
